instruction: Cinematic film still, medium shot from behind. In a plant-filled room, the blonde woman in a grey cardigan (R2) on the left and the smiling dark-haired man in a light polo shirt (R1) on the right raise their hands to share a high-five. Their hands meet in the center against a window background with a hanging globe light. Warm, natural light fills the space.
elements: R1 actively raises his hand toward R2's raised hand for the high-five
R2 actively raises her hand toward R1's raised hand for the high-five
R1 and R2 make hand-to-hand contact in the center as a high-five
R1 and R2 are both shown from behind while their raised hands meet
The high-five happens in a plant-filled room with a window background and hanging globe light
